title: Great in my van.
text: Great in my van.. I love blankets. I can never have enough but strangely I didn't have 1 in my van like I used to. I got this 1 to keep in my van for those who get a chill while we're out traveling.It's beautiful colors are a nice and bright blue and white. The size is just right to cover anyone And keep them warm and cool and cozy. Makes a great gift for anyone who likes to snuggle Especially to keep in a vehicle
